126 open sanctions from May sitting unsettled — 95% stuck on registration pending or builder document gaps (not lost).
30-60 day pipeline converting at 30%, 60-90 day at 26% — old backlog converting; resale transactions increasing (30%→45% in Delhi).

Right lender selection: manual HTML calculator deployed, 80% accuracy; moving to BRD automation.
Yodha task system live; only 20% of tasks resolved by sales team despite three training sessions.
Periscope WhatsApp tracking live then blocked within 2 days — number flagged as spam.
Bot calling: 30% of D2C QLs in May generated by bot; hot call transfer pilot: 2 transfers done, issues being resolved.

When will MAHADA new leads arrive — expected this week but delayed by one week from MAHADA side?
Hyderabad visibility dropping this month — what is the issue?
